description: YRD_PV_2025: the spatial distribution of solar photovoltaic installation dataset across the Yangtze River Delta, China in 2025 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yingyi Xie, Sijie Deng (Nanjing Normal University). Solar energy is the most common renewable energy source that is clean, safe, and inexhaustible. Photovoltaic (PV) technology utilizes solar panels to convert solar energy into electricity. The number of PV installations has rapidly increased worldwide. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
